archetypes.name: assert-mode-regression
archetypes.rationale: Case (e) uses assert_equal_stdout (full-stdout pin) while the plan switches it to assert_contains; this weakens coverage, and negative-assertion substrings for cases (g)/(h) risk collisions with valid output tokens like 'true' in FAILED=true.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the four test cases being reshaped (e)/(f)/(g)/(h) in scripts/test-tracking-issue-read-sentinel.sh and verify that the plan's switch from assert_equal_stdout to assert_contains for case (e) does not allow unexpected extra tokens in the FAILED+ERROR stdout to go uncaught. For cases (g) ('ADOPTED=1') and (h) ('ADOPTED=true\u0020' trailing space), evaluate whether the proposed assert_not_contains substrings are specific enough: a bare '1' would match 'FAILED=true'; asserting absence of the full 'ADOPTED=1' raw token is safe, but confirm the plan's described substring matches that form and not a shorter ambiguous fragment. Compare each reshaped block against the (p)/(q)/(t)-(w) ISSUE_NUMBER/RUN_ID precedent cases at lines 276-346 to confirm byte-identical assertion structure. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-old-format-sweep
archetypes.rationale: The old envelope string appears in CHANGELOG.md and potentially larch-logs beyond the five plan-scoped files; the plan does not address whether those references are intentionally excluded.
archetypes.prompt_body: Search for all occurrences of 'invalid ADOPTED value in sentinel' across the repository, not only the five files named in the plan. Flag any match outside larch-logs/ and CHANGELOG.md that the plan does not assign an update step, because a stale reference in an active doc or workflow would leave the documented contract inconsistent with the new behavior. Also confirm that tracking-issue-read.md's 'Malformed-value redaction' note (around line 155) is the only cross-key summary referencing ISSUE_NUMBER and RUN_ID together, so that broadening it to include ADOPTED is a complete rather than partial update. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-output-parser
archetypes.rationale: The plan performs no caller sweep; if any script outside the five-file list parses ERROR= field content (not just FAILED=true) from tracking-issue-read.sh's --sentinel branch, the format change silently breaks it.
archetypes.prompt_body: Grep for callers of tracking-issue-read.sh across skills/, hooks/, .github/workflows/, and other scripts/, then check whether any caller inspects the ERROR= field value rather than stopping at FAILED=true. If a caller does string-match or display the old 'invalid ADOPTED value in sentinel: \u2019<val>\u2019' form, it falls outside the plan's scope and needs a separate update. Also verify that the plan's claim that no behavior change occurs in get-issue-context.sh is accurate — confirm that adding only a comment there cannot introduce any Bash 3.2 incompatibility given the shell-strict-mode rule. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
